_notes: Sector class from the SEC SIC code in submissions.json (ADR-033). Drives the ADR-013 exceptions. The GICS sector from the S&P 500 snapshot (ADR-014) will confirm or override this later. Ranges are inclusive [low, high].

rules.why: Commercial banks and savings institutions: no classified balance sheet, operating income or capex.
Life, accident, health, property-casualty and title insurers, and insurance agents: same reporting shape as banks.
Electric, combined electric-gas and cogeneration utilities: Graham's G2 variant (debt <= 2x equity).
